children.name: Limopsis aurita
children.description: Bathymetric distribution: 20 – 1900 m — WBD. Geographical distribution: Mediterranean, through the Northwest Atlantic, to Norway; Canary Islands, Azores, Iceland, Newfoundland, Bermuda and Virgin Islands, Gulf of Mexico, Texas; Brazil (AL to SP) — WGD. References: Oliver & Allen (1980 b), Rios (1994, 2009), Amaral et al. (2006).

children.description: Bathymetric distribution: 20 – 3500 m — WBD. References: Oliver & Allen (1980 b), Rios (1994, 2009), Amaral et al. (2006).
